children: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (NSE:TCS) is expanding its fintech and tech footprint—partnering with Dubai Gold & Commodities Exchange to deploy TCS BaNCS/Quartz for derivatives and emerging assets while launching custom SoC design services and backing a $7bn, 1GW data‑center push amid recent workforce trims.
: TCS partners with Dubai Gold & Commodities Exchange to implement an integrated trading, clearing and surveillance platform for derivatives and emerging asset classes; TCS shares reacted positively.
: TCS will deploy TCS BaNCS and Quartz stack with AI reporting and analytics to support trading and clearing of energy, FX, equities, bullion and precious metals, enhancing product dev and risk tools

: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (TCS), via Tata Sons, committed $7 billion in October 2025 to develop 1 gigawatt of data-center capacity as the first investor in the group's data-center initiatives.
: FY2026: TCS trimmed workforce as part of a group reduction of 6,981 staff; earlier cuts in July removed about 12,000 mid-to-senior executives.
: TCS launched custom SoC design services for automotive OEMs and chip partners, offering end-to-end architecture, VLSI, HW‑SW co‑design, verification and validation for software‑defined vehicles.
